meta.title: Fire on the station

moments.caption: Raphaël smells smoke and tells Astrum. Everyone is told at once, and a message goes to Earth.

notices.title: Emergency: Fire
notices.body: Declared by Raphaël. Open Astrum for the steps.

title.en: A fire on the space station.

lines.en: Someone smells smoke in one of the modules.
lines.pt: Alguém sente cheiro de fumaça em um dos módulos.

notes: Simulated scenario, recorded from the real hub in demo mode: every message is what the hub sent a shared screen.
The crew, their bodies and readings are the demo hub's simulated data. No sensor detected the event: a crewmate declared it.
Thinned for size: each signal of each room and person is kept at most once every 15 seconds, a replayed value also whenever it changes; evidence cards only when they change. Clock ticks are left out.

cardViews.title: Smoke and toxic air
steps: Leave the room now, go to a room with good air, and close the hatch behind you.
Put on the protective mask. If you do not have one, cover your nose and mouth with a wet cloth.
Tell everyone: fire, smoke or a strange smell. Check the screen to see where the problem is.
Do not go back into the room. Do not try to put out a big fire alone.
Look again in a few minutes. If you have a strong cough, trouble breathing, confusion or fainting: follow the urgent card.
doNot: Do not go back into the room.
Do not try to put out a big fire alone.

sources.name: NASA Appendix E, table E.2-2: smoke and combustion product inhalation, toxic inhalation injury and burns secondary to fire are on the table

unverified: All steps written from memory, no source for the steps.
The NASA table says these conditions are considered; it gives no steps or warning levels.

The ship's own fire and toxic-atmosphere procedures (hatch, masks, fire extinguishers) were not read; this card is only about what the person should do first. The medical lead or Caio should check them against the real procedures.
The medical lead gave no sources for this card.

report.summary: Incident report: Fire, level 3, declared, crew told.
